name: Sonne Finance soVELO empty-market donation
summary: Sonne's timelock queued the listing of an empty soVELO market with a 35% collateral factor, executable by anyone after the delay. The attacker executed it, minted 2 wei of soVELO and donated VELO to inflate the Compound-v2 exchange rate, borrowed other markets' assets against that collateral, and recovered the donation via redeemUnderlying rounding.
notes: The reset is the timelock schedule of the soVELO listing, reserve factor, rate model, oracle and 35% collateral factor (one tx), not the market's deployment: the exploit needed the listing and the collateral factor, and with EXECUTOR_ROLE held by address(0) anyone could execute them once the delay passed.

Gross depletion of the 11 markets listed before the anchor, from loss.mjs. wstETH (unpriced on Optimism) uses Ethereum wstETH at the block and USDT is at par (DefiLlama quoted 1.021). The VELO donation the attacker redeemed is its own round trip; the helper-to-helper soVELO transfers are not exploits.
